prompt: Return JSON only. Put the result in answer. Compute: a shop has 17 boxes with 24 items each, sells 139 items, then receives 5 boxes with 18 items each. Return remaining_items and parity (even or odd).

Return JSON only in exactly this shape: {"answer":{"schedule":["A","B","C","D","E"]}} with the array replaced by the unique solution. Schedule A-E into slots 1-5. B is immediately after D. A is before C. E is after C. A is not slot 1. D is before A.

Return JSON only with top-level answer. A pipeline has tasks: ingest(4m), validate(3m after ingest), enrich(6m after validate), index(5m after enrich), audit(7m after validate), publish(2m after both index and audit). Unlimited workers are available. If enrich duration is reduced by 2 minutes, compute original_minutes, optimized_minutes, original_critical_path as an array of task names, and saved_minutes.

Return JSON only. The top-level object must contain only answer. Inside answer use exactly these keys: max_name, first_sum, second_sum, descending, median_margin. For records [(alpha,17,4),(beta,23,9),(gamma,11,5),(delta,29,8),(epsilon,19,7),(zeta,31,15),(eta,13,3)], compute: name with highest first-minus-second value; sum of all first values; sum of all second values; names sorted by first-minus-second descending, breaking ties alphabetically; and median of all first-minus-second margins.
